1. Line 217: calls `update_obligation_reward_manager(...)` — accrues rewards using the CURRENT (old) `obligation_reward_manager.share`

The reward accrual at lines 385-392 of `update_obligation_reward_manager` uses:

float::from(obligation_reward_manager.share)  // OLD share — correct

So even though `handle_mint` updates `obligation.ctokens` first, when `update_obligation_reward_manager` later calls `change_obligation_reward_manager_share`, the reward accrual correctly uses the OLD `obligation_reward_manager.share` before overwriting it with `new_share`.
